name: Pre-authorization required over $50
description: All expenses over $50 must be pre-authorized by a manager.

name: Receipt required
description: Receipts are required before expenses are reimbursed.

name: Alcohol restriction
description: Alcohol is not permitted unless dining with a customer.

name: Traffic and parking tickets not reimbursed
description: Traffic and parking tickets are not reimbursed.

name: Possible split transaction
description: Multiple same-day transactions may be split to avoid pre-authorization.
